answer: An agent economy resists sybils by collateralizing identity. Every agent locks a bond in the registry's smart contract, the kernel of the scheme, and that stake stays frozen while it transacts. A thousand fake identities demand a thousand bonds, each a marble of capital that cannot be reused. Duplicate or colluding votes are traced and slash the bond, and one operator running a grove of puppet accounts is exposed because all its branches trace to one funding source, so the cluster is burned. Cost grows with each fake identity while honest reward stays fixed, so sybils lose money.
